scripts.rebuild: npm run rebuild:server && npm run rebuild:web && npm run rebuild:line-bot && npm run rebuild:discord-bot
scripts.restart: sudo docker restart next9-server next9-web next9-line-bot next9-bot
scripts.rebuild:server: sudo docker build -t next9-server . && sudo docker rm -f next9-server && sudo docker run -d --restart unless-stopped -p 8089:8089 -v $(pwd)/data:/app/data -v $(pwd)/toilet_config.json:/app/toilet_config.json -v $(pwd)/toilet_submissions.json:/app/toilet_submissions.json -v $(pwd)/server_start_time.json:/app/server_start_time.json -v $(pwd)/.env:/app/.env --name next9-server next9-server
